label: LINE
terms_note: Needs a LINE Official Account + a Messaging API channel; reply messages are free, push / multicast / narrowcast / broadcast consume the plan's monthly message quota (free tier 200 messages/month in JP; paid Light / Standard plans; JP additional-message fees revised 2026-10-01); channel access tokens (long-lived, or v2.1 JWT-assertion tokens); webhook must answer over HTTPS; rate limits are per endpoint (e.g. Get rich menu list cut from 2,000 rps to 10 rps on 2026-05-26).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (messaging; the VOOM feed is being discontinued).
auth: 1. Tenant creates a **LINE Official Account**, then a Messaging API channel in the LINE Developers Console.
2. Channel access token: long-lived token from the console, or v2.1 tokens issued by JWT assertion
3. Webhook URL (HTTPS) verified from the console; verify `x-line-signature` (HMAC-SHA256 with the channel secret).
reference.limits: - Reply messages free; push / multicast / narrowcast / broadcast consume the Official Account plan's monthly quota (free plan 200 messages/month in JP; JP additional-message fees revised 2026-10-01). - Rate limits are per endpoint (Get rich menu list cut from 2,000 rps to 10 rps on 2026-05-26; send endpoints are documented in the "Rate limits" section of the reference). - **LINE VOOM is scheduled to be discontinued** (news 2026-08-26) — no organic feed publishing to plan for. - LINE Official Account terms: no spam, unsubscribe honoured (block), Japanese specified-commercial-transaction rules.

fields.name: channel_access_token
fields.help: Channel access token of the LINE Official Account's Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer in https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml).

adapter.terms: LINE is a messaging / broadcast surface (LINE VOOM is being discontinued): a 'post' here is a broadcast to every friend of the Official Account, counted against the plan's monthly message quota.

me.note: 'Get bot info' returns userId, basicId, premiumId, displayName, pictureUrl, chatMode and markAsReadMode of the Official Account.

publish_text.note: PUBLISHES TO EVERY FRIEND: POST /v2/bot/message/broadcast {messages: [{type: 'text', text}]} 'Sends a message to multiple users at any time' - every user who added the Official Account receives it and each delivery counts against the plan's monthly message quota (409 when the quota is exhausted). The response body is empty ({}); the only identifier, the x-line-request-id response header, is not exposed, so `id` is the literal 'broadcast'. `reply_to` is ignored (a broadcast cannot reply). No X-Line-Retry-Key is sent, so a retried call can deliver twice.

publish_image.note: PUBLISHES TO EVERY FRIEND: broadcast of one image message {type: 'image', originalContentUrl, previewImageUrl} (both HTTPS URLs; JPEG/PNG; the first image_urls entry is used for both). Only the first image is sent and `text` is NOT sent (broadcast it separately with publish_text). Counts against the monthly message quota; `id` is the literal 'broadcast' because the request id travels only in a response header.

analytics_post.note: 'Get user interaction statistics' of a broadcast or narrowcast: `post_id` is the request ID of that send (the x-line-request-id response header, visible in the LINE Developers Console or your own logs - publish_text cannot return it). Counts are top-level fields (delivered, unique_impression, unique_click; LINE returns null below 20); per-bubble `messages` and `clicks` stay under raw.

not_offered.read_comments: Broadcasts have no comments: user replies arrive only as webhook events to the channel's webhook URL (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#webhooks); there is no message-history endpoint.
not_offered.reply_comment: POST /v2/bot/message/reply needs the short-lived single-use `replyToken` of a webhook event, not a comment id (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#send-reply-message).
not_offered.read_mentions: Group mentions are delivered only inside webhook message events (mention.mentionees, https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#wh-text); no REST feed exists.
not_offered.delete: A sent message cannot be recalled: the Messaging API reference (https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml) defines no delete / unsend operation for messages.
